summary: Manages reversible overlays of object attribute replacements with independent activation scopes.

traps.quote: For each replacement, resolve its path after all preceding replacements in that same activation have been applied
traps.consequence: Solution pre-resolves all paths, gets wrong cells on tests where path depends on prior replacements
traps.guard: Resolve each path after all prior replacements in its activation are applied to state

traps.quote: STOPALL stops all active activations from newest to oldest. Each complete restoration occurs before the next
traps.consequence: Solution stops oldest-to-newest instead, leaves cells with values from wrong activation order
traps.guard: Stop from newest to oldest by reversing active activation queue order when processing STOPALL

traps.quote: Each restoration writes the remembered value even if another activation later changed that cell
traps.consequence: Solution writes current cell value instead of remembered value, loses earlier overlay changes
traps.guard: Use remembered values from before each replacement, not current cell state during restoration

traps.quote: restore that activation's remembered writes in reverse replacement order
traps.consequence: Solution restores replacements forward instead of reverse, cell ends in wrong intermediate state
traps.guard: Reverse the replacement list when restoring, process from last replacement to first

traps.consequence: Solution indexes cells with array sized by attribute, crashes out-of-memory or panics
traps.guard: Use HashMap or BTreeMap keyed by (object, attribute) pair for sparse cell storage

traps.quote: The ID is guaranteed inactive before START, but may be reused after stopping
traps.consequence: Solution stores state per ID globally, merges independent activations with same reused ID
traps.guard: Track each activation separately by ID, allow ID reuse only after previous activation stops

input_shape: N, K, Q (≤200k); K initial cells; Q commands (START with total M ≤200k, STOP, STOPALL, GET, STACK); path length sum ≤400k
output_shape: GET prints 'I value' or 'O value'; STACK prints activation count and IDs oldest-to-newest on one line
invariants: Each cell is uniquely identified by (object, attribute); attributes span 1..=10^9
Paths resolve against current state at use time, not pre-computed or reused
Activation order determines restoration order: STOPALL goes newest-to-oldest
max_scale: 200k objects, 200k cells, 200k commands; 200k total replacements; 400k total path length
